title: Automotive Ethernet Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Automotive Ethernet Engineer with strong expertise in C++ development, Automotive Ethernet technologies, and real-time operating systems. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and validating Automotive Ethernet software solutions for next-generation automotive platforms. This role requires hands-on experience with networking protocols, multi-threaded application development, protocol analysis, and debugging in Linux and QNX environments. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Automotive Ethernet software components for embedded automotive platforms. Design, implement, and optimize networking applications using modern C++. Develop software supporting TCP/IP communication and multi-threaded applications. Implement and validate Automotive Ethernet and AVB protocol functionalities. Perform protocol analysis, packet capture, and debugging using Wireshark and tcpdump. Work on software development in QNX and Linux operating systems. Create and maintain software design documentation using Enterprise Architect (EA). Collaborate with cross-functional teams during design, integration, testing, and validation. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions. Troubleshoot and resolve software and communication-related issues. 
 Required Skills 4 to 9 years of experience in embedded or automotive software development. Strong programming skills in C++.. Strong understanding of TCP/IP protocols and multi-threaded application development. Hands-on experience with Automotive Ethernet (IEEE 802.3u/802.3ab). Experience with AVB protocols (IEEE 802.1AS). Strong working knowledge of QNX and Linux operating systems. Experience using Wireshark and tcpdump for protocol analysis and debugging. Experience with Enterprise Architect (EA). Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Skills Experience with automotive communication stacks and embedded networking. Exposure to automotive software development processes and standards. Experience working in Agile software development environments. Knowledge of Python scripting for automation is an added advantage. Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools. 
 Interested? Apply here or drop your resume at apin.lal@gadgeon.com

Key Skills: C++,Linux,Automotive Ethernet,Automotive Embedded Systems,Enterprise Architect,AVB Protocols,Automotive,Embedded Software Development
